description: CamMe – The Control is in Your Hands! CamMe is a new camera app that lets you take great pictures. Like to take great selfies or group shots of you and your friends? Enjoy taking pictures with CamMe on your computer. Click with mouse, or tap on touch panel, CamMe starts countdown. 3, 2, 1, CamMe takes your picture. If your PC supports hand gesture, you can take pictures from distance without even touching PC. CamMe is available only for Fujitsu PC. And PointGrab Hand Gesture Control V 3.13 or later supports CamMe.
